items.title: Mamdani to New York City kids: No AI until high school
items.summary: NYC, which boasts the largest school system in the nation, issued a one-year moratorium on AI in city elementary and middle schools.
items.titleZh: Mamdani对纽约市的孩子们说：直到高中才有人工智能
items.summaryZh: 拥有全国最大学校系统的纽约市发布了一项为期一年的城市中小学人工智能禁令。

items.title: Mamdani expels AI from the classroom for 600,000 students
items.summary: The new guidelines will block or delete AI from school software used by elementary and middle school students, as well as limits on screen time.
items.titleZh: Mamdani为60万名学生从课堂上驱逐人工智能
items.summaryZh: 新的指导方针将阻止或删除中小学生使用的学校软件中的人工智能，并限制屏幕时间。

items.title: UKG’s CIO says HR tech is AI’s next big bet. The software firm’s employees have already launched 387 AI tools and over 12,000 agents
items.summary: After two decades at Autodesk, Prakash “PK” Kota joined UKG to give 14,000 broad access to AI tools and encourage them to build thousands of agents to automate work.
items.titleZh: UKG的首席信息官表示，人力资源技术是人工智能的下一个大赌注。该软件公司的员工已经推出了387种人工智能工具和12000多名代理
items.summaryZh: 在Autodesk工作了二十年后，Prakash“PK”Kota加入了UKG，为14000人提供了广泛的人工智能工具，并鼓励他们构建数千个代理来自动化工作。

items.title: The Trump administration is supporting OpenAI in the NYT copyright lawsuit

items.titleZh: 特朗普政府在《纽约时报》版权诉讼中支持OpenAI
items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府干预了《纽约时报》对OpenAI的版权诉讼，为人工智能实验室辩护。这起具有里程碑意义的诉讼于2023年12月提起，指控OpenAI在T的文章上非法训练其人工智能系统…

items.title: India's richest man now wants to turn aging computers into AI-ready PCs
items.summary: Jio is betting it can turn an aging computer into an AI-ready PC for as little as about $11 for two months.
items.titleZh: 印度首富现在想把老化的电脑变成支持人工智能的个人电脑
items.summaryZh: Jio押注它可以在两个月内以低至11美元的价格将一台老化的电脑变成一台支持人工智能的个人电脑。

items.title: HiddenLayer nabs $100M as enterprises rush to secure their AI deployments
items.summary: HiddenLayer has raised a $100M Series B from Delta-v Capital, Ten Eleven Ventures, Morgan Stanley, Microsoft's M12, Booz Allen Hamilton, and others.
items.titleZh: HiddenLayer获得1亿美元，因为企业急于保护其人工智能部署
items.summaryZh: HiddenLayer已经从Delta-v Capital、Ten Eleven Ventures、摩根士丹利、微软的M12、博思艾伦咨询公司等公司筹集了1亿美元的B轮融资。

items.title: Range Rover’s first luxury electric SUV costs $140,000 and delivers V8 power [Images]
items.summary:
The Range Rover Electric is now on sale with prices starting at about $140,000. It’s expensive, but the electric SUV is “the most accomplished Range Rover ever,” offering a quieter, more refined drive.

items.titleZh: 路虎揽胜首款豪华电动SUV售价14万美元，提供V8动力[图片]
items.summaryZh: 路虎揽胜电动版现已上市，起价约为14万美元。它很贵，但电动SUV是“有史以来最成功的路虎揽胜”，提供更安静、更精致的驾驶体验。

items.title: Tesla settles fatal Autopilot fire truck lawsuit, avoiding jury trial
items.summary:
Tesla has settled a wrongful death lawsuit over a 2023 crash in which a Model S on Autopilot slammed into a parked fire truck, killing the driver and seriously injuring his brother.



The confidential settlement, filed in California federal court, lets Tesla…
items.titleZh: 特斯拉解决致命的自动驾驶消防车诉讼，避免陪审团审判
items.summaryZh: 特斯拉已就2023年的一起事故解决了一起过失死亡诉讼，在该事故中，一辆装有自动驾驶仪的Model S撞上了一辆停放的消防车，导致司机死亡，其兄弟严重受伤。

items.titleZh: 特斯拉新款Model Y L在中国出现悬架问题
items.summaryZh: 特斯拉新款Model Y L的几位中国车主，即流行的Model Y的较大3排版本，将前往中国社交媒体抱怨悬架倒塌问题——这个问题已经足够让粉丝们开发出一种“手指法”来测试…
